flag: none; Job A only via the hash-pinned approved list (not in approved.json until Peace posts /approve-rule on its proposal issue)
engine: v4's list search (peaceai/lib/derive-list.ts) with a nonFinite flag, reached through the same rule kind in peaceai/lib/learned-derive.ts, bound to v4's DERIVE_LIST_TRIGGER with the params dsl typed-dsl-v6-nonfinite and placement new-or-existing-module-v6 (all three or derive_params). An example number (a list element, a record field, the scalar parameter or the result) may also be written NaN, Infinity or -Infinity. Values are compared by a key under which NaN, Infinity and -Infinity are each their own value (Object.is, as node:assert/strict compares; v4 read all three as null). The search adds Number.isFinite(E) and !Number.isFinite(E) as predicates for a field whose example elements show a non-finite value, probes every number slot also with NaN, Infinity and -Infinity, and never counts a non-finite value as edge or far-side evidence. After every v4 gate, the nonfinite gate checks the accepted program against its non-finite twins (a comparison with a NaN side that holds, NaN elements left out, non-finite elements left out, NaN whenever the list holds a NaN): any twin that fits every example and differs on a twin probe (each example list with NaN, Infinity or -Infinity added first or last, alone or twice, and each number argument set to one) refuses with the row that tells them apart. The generated test asserts the examples as written (assert.equal / assert.deepEqual from node:assert/strict). Job B (test-candidates.ts) re-checks a v6 candidate by its own operation id with the v6 checks (Number.isFinite is the one global it may call; Number is never a name); v1-v5 candidates exactly as before
scope: a v4-shaped issue (either header; one list parameter of numbers, strings, booleans or simple records plus at most one number or string parameter) whose Examples hold at least one NaN, Infinity or -Infinity; a task with none is not_needed (v4 answers it), so v4 and v6 never both answer one task. The Behavior paragraph still may not name NaN, Infinity or Number (it can say 'not a finite number')
refusals: not_needed (no non-finite example value); derive_under_specified_nonfinite (a reading outside the DSL that agrees on every finite input, such as NaN-propagating Math.max or a comparison written !(x < c), fits the examples and differs on a non-finite value; the asked row tells them apart); derive_reserved_name (the function or a parameter named Number, besides v4's); every v4 refusal (derive_examples, derive_signature, derive_under_specified_*, derive_no_fit, derive_ambiguous with asked rows, derive_budget, derive_list_expr, derive_params, the v1/v3 path and append refusals, new_test_path_exists)

evidence.method: upstream evidence for list functions on examples holding NaN / Infinity / -Infinity: M113's 20 number-reading upstream functions plus 4 new Number.isFinite / isFinite functions (GitHub code search, MIT / Apache-2.0 / ISC only), each re-derived by the v6 search from a seeded grid slice (seed 136) plus only the rows its refusals asked for (answered by the upstream function) and checked against the upstream function on every held-out grid and probe row; the grid generator and the check are committed (peaceai/test/m136-evidence-run.ts) and the evidence test recomputes every count
evidence.note: Does not qualify yet. After the G17 nonfinite gate, 14 derive with 0 wrong on 4355 held-out rows (2589 with a non-finite value), 10 are refused, and none derives wrong: the 5 Math.max / Math.min functions that were wrong on 11 rows each are now asked for a NaN row and refused (derive_no_fit), as no v6 program propagates NaN. qualifies stays false because v6 has no evidence bar of its own: the v1-v3 derive bar is 10 and these 14 (14 repos) would pass it, but only 3 of the 14 derivations (filterFinite, compact, hasInvalidNumber) use a non-finite test themselves; the other 11 are integer functions whose NaN / Infinity results follow from plain arithmetic. Whether that is enough for /approve-rule is for Auditor and Peace to set, not this file. See the note in the evidence file.

limits: Phase 1 only (GAPS G17): the scalar engines (v1-v3) and v5 still refuse non-finite examples; there is no finite guard on the scalar parameter alone (only on list elements or their fields); record results and calls to other modules (G16) are out of scope, so the weekly-review wiring task is still refused. -0 is never written in an example and shares 0's key. Every limit of v4 applies.
